column1: # LABEL-VALUE-1 lexicon: a sensitive label whose next value is masked.
#   class  SECRET (Secret), COOKIE (Secret, the rest of the line holding `=`),
#          ID (NATIONAL_ID), HEALTH (HEALTH, a record or plan number), BLOOD (HEALTH, a blood group),
#          MEMBER (HEALTH, a number after a label that is health only near a health word).
#   link   any = the value may follow with no link (`MRN 448812`, `the pin, 7198`);
#          punct = only after `:`, `=`, `#` or a number word (`pwd`, `tin`, `health plan no.`);
#          number = only when a number word comes first (`licence number`, `licence no.`, `Nr`, `n°`).
# Labels are written folded: lower case, no accents, `_` and `-` read as a space.
# A number word after a label (`no.`, `Nr`, `n°`, `number`) is a link, so `passport` covers
# `passport no.`; a number word glued to its value is read with it (`n°12AB34567`,
# ID-LABEL-2). List a longer label only when its words differ. Left out on purpose:
# `id number` (payment_ids owns it, with its business exclusions). `licence`/`license` alone is no label: it is a word before a
# fee, a date or a version (`licence: 2024-10-01`), and the number behind it is read by
# its structure under the licence rule of id_label.rs instead. Followed by a number word
# it is one (`licence number 12AB34567`, `Licence No. …`, ID-LABEL-1; a business
# certificate's number is masked with it), so it is listed with the `number` link.
